Name: More Giant Crop Locations (CP)
Author: dyanosis
Description:
Giant Crops will be possible in the Greenhouse and on Ginger Island's Farm. This should work on every mod that updates the size/texture of the Greenhouse, as long as they updated the Greenhouse and didn't create a new map.

[b]Config[/b]
[list]
[*][b]In Greenhouse [/b]- Whether Giant Crops will spawn in the Greenhouse.
[*][b]On Ginger Island[/b]- Whether Giant Crops will spawn on Ginger Island.
[/list]
Changes to the config will require you to change locations (aka leave the Greenhouse and re-enter or go to some other part of Ginger Island and then go back to the farm).

You DO NOT need the main file in order to use one of the optional compatibility files. They are done this way so you can include or exclude anything you want and individually enable/disable them through their own mod menus.

[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[*]Lnh's More Farm (optional file)
[*]Lnh's More Custom Farms (optional file)
[*]SVE (Stardew Valley Expanded) - Most farms and the Greenhouse
[*]Grampleton Fields (SVE required, optional file)
[*]East Scarp (East Scarp required, optional file)
[/list][*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
If you'd like me to add compatibility for an expansion, leave a Comment or message me on here! The worst I can say is "no" and the worst you can do is not ask.

[b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url] for encouraging people to develop mods to adjust Giant Crops.
[*]People on Nexus for being so open to people wanting to be creative.
[/list]
